evidence.title: Prototype sample: firewall
evidence.text: A firewall filters network traffic according to a defined security policy.

evidence.title: Prototype sample: firewall
evidence.text: Stateful firewalls track connection state when deciding whether to allow packets.

evidence.title: Prototype sample: firewall
evidence.text: A default-deny firewall policy blocks traffic unless an explicit rule permits it.

evidence.title: Prototype sample: cryptography
evidence.text: Symmetric encryption uses the same secret key for encryption and decryption.

evidence.title: Prototype sample: cryptography
evidence.text: Public-key cryptography uses a related public key and private key with different roles.

evidence.title: Prototype sample: cryptography
evidence.text: A digital signature can support message integrity and signer authentication; it does not by itself provide confidentiality.

evidence.title: Prototype sample: authentication
evidence.text: Authentication verifies identity, while authorization determines permitted actions.

evidence.title: Prototype sample: authentication
evidence.text: Multi-factor authentication combines factors from different categories, such as a password and a hardware token.

evidence.title: Prototype sample: authentication
evidence.text: A unique salt helps prevent identical passwords from producing identical stored password hashes.
